scheme_name: Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana
description:
The Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttar Pradesh.

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2021.

It aims to provide financial assistance to the children of laborers and workers in the unorganized sector.

The primary objective of this scheme is to encourage education among the children of laborers.

The scheme specifically targets children who are studying in classes 1 to 12.

The government aims to provide scholarships to these children to reduce the financial burden on their families.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to promote educational attainment.

The government has set a target to benefit at least 1 lakh children under this scheme annually.

The total budget allocated for this scheme is approximately INR 50 crores.

Under the Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana, students will receive a scholarship amount of INR 1,000 per year.

This scholarship is provided to students from classes 1 to 8.

For students in classes 9 to 12, the scholarship amount is increased to INR 2,000 per year.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and well-defined.

To be eligible for the scholarship, the applicant must be a child of a registered laborer in the unorganized sector.

The laborer must have a valid registration under the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1979.

The applicant must be studying in a recognized school.

There are no specific age limits mentioned for eligibility.

However, the educational requirement is that the child must be enrolled in classes 1 to 12.

The income criteria for the laborer parents is that their annual income should not exceed INR 3 lakhs.

The application process for the Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana is straightforward.

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Uttar Pradesh government.

The application form can be submitted online.

Applicants must provide certain documents along with the application form.

These documents include a copy of the labor registration certificate.

A copy of the student’s school ID or admission certificate is also required.

Additionally, applicants must submit proof of income.

This can be in the form of an income certificate issued by a competent authority.

The application process also requires the submission of a passport-sized photograph of the student.

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities.

The verification process includes checking the eligibility of the applicant.

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank account of the eligible student.

The disbursement of the scholarship is done annually.

The government aims to complete the disbursement process by the end of the academic year.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Uttar Pradesh.

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Directorate of Labour Welfare.

The contact details for the Directorate of Labour Welfare are available on the official Uttar Pradesh government website.

The Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana is part of a broader initiative to support the education of children from economically weaker sections.

The scheme is named after Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi, a prominent freedom fighter and educationist.

This initiative reflects the government's commitment to improving literacy rates among marginalized communities.

The scheme aims to bridge the educational gap faced by children of laborers.

It is expected to empower these children by providing them with the necessary financial support for their education.

The government has emphasized the importance of education in breaking the cycle of poverty.

By providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to motivate students to continue their studies.

The scholarship can significantly alleviate the financial burden on families struggling to afford educational expenses.

The initiative is also expected to promote higher enrollment rates in schools.

The scheme aligns with the National Education Policy 2020, which emphasizes equitable access to education.

The government has launched awareness campaigns to inform eligible families about the scheme.

These campaigns aim to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries.

The Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana is a step towards inclusive education.

It aims to create a more educated workforce in the future.

The scheme is part of the Uttar Pradesh government's larger vision to uplift the unorganized sector.

The government is continuously monitoring the implementation of the scheme.

Feedback from beneficiaries is being collected to improve the scheme further.

The success of the Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana will be measured through increased enrollment and retention rates in schools.

The government is committed to making education accessible to all children, regardless of their socio-economic background.

This initiative is a crucial part of the state’s efforts to promote social justice and equality.

The scheme reflects the government's understanding of the challenges faced by laborers and their families.

The Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana is a vital tool in the fight against educational inequality in Uttar Pradesh.

It aims to ensure that no child is left behind in the pursuit of education.

The government encourages all eligible families to take advantage of this scheme.

By doing so, they can secure a better future for their children through education.
